notes: Twixxel's Stalker is a lot scarier now. It comes far more often - a stalk every 4 minutes, something right behind you every 8, a chase every 15, and twice as often at night and in storms.

It finally does what its description promised: it creeps closer every time you look away, and at night it looks in through your windows - tapping on the glass until you see it. Look away and it is gone. Stare too long and the lights go out.
